title: An omitted starting mode
scope: A preview panel has exactly two abstract modes, quiet and loud. There are no hidden variables or external effects. The written rule is the entire available specification; unspecified behavior cannot be assumed to preserve the state.

operations.name: Make quiet
operations.rule: From quiet remain quiet. From loud become quiet. This operation is enabled in both declared modes.

operations.name: Incomplete refresh
operations.rule: From quiet remain quiet. This is the complete specification; no behavior or enablement is specified for loud.
